milestone: M46 Headless Mode Pack Update Continuation

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets headless.continue_once perform one authorized, replay-safe active Mode Pack replacement from M46.1 selected fetch, M46.2 provenance, and M46.3 approval checkpoints.
Moves the selected registry update pipeline from approved candidate evidence to an installed active Mode Pack through existing Rust runtime replacement authority.

Requires explicit continuation replacement authorization and fails closed on stale progress, mismatched checkpoint evidence, stale active snapshot identity, consumed approvals, or mismatched candidate activation fingerprint.
Persists bounded replacement continuation checkpoint evidence and replays without duplicating active replacement or candidate-consumed ledger events.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can replace the active Mode Pack with one selected approved candidate through existing modepack.replaceActive authority, returning bounded replacement evidence and a refresh route.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: modepack.replaceActive can replace caller-supplied approved candidates, while M46 continuations produce selected fetch/provenance/approval evidence; no runtime-owned continuation previously bound those checkpoints to active replacement and replay-safe approval consumption.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless Mode Pack update pipelines remain stuck after selected candidate approval and still need caller glue to perform active replacement outside the continuation ledger.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M46.1 fetched selected candidates, M46.2 verified selected provenance, M46.3 approved selected verified candidates, and M46.4 performs the next lifecycle mutation: active replacement plus approval consumption.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This extends the existing headless.continue_once request/result shape and does not add a new RPC.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It uses existing ModePackReplaceActiveResult and bounded continuation checkpoint metadata, not a report or digest wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime validates fresh progress, explicit replacement authorization, M46.1/M46.2/M46.3 checkpoints, registry selection evidence, active snapshot identity, candidate/provenance/approval/signer fingerprints, then performs one active replacement side effect and replays without duplicate replacement evidence.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can advance from approved selected candidate trust state to an active replacement deterministically, closing the selected Mode Pack update pipeline mutation.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the final executable M46 update-pipeline step before milestone closeout assessment.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M46.4 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the M46.4 value gate. Review must confirm this is selected approved candidate active replacement execution, not a report/readiness wrapper.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts a bounded modepack_selected_approved_candidate_replacement_target with explicit authorization

runtime revalidates M46.1 fetch continuation id, fetch decision id, M46.2 provenance continuation id, provenance decision id, M46.3 approval continuation id, approval decision id, selection id/event id, candidate URL/content/policy/activation fingerprints, provenance id/event id, statement URL/hash, signer fingerprint, current activation fingerprint, and approved candidate identity before replacement mutation
runtime delegates to existing modepack.replaceActive authority and returns bounded ModePackReplaceActiveResult
successful replacement consumes the approved candidate and records exactly one candidate-consumed ledger event
same-request replay returns bounded replacement evidence and does not append duplicate active replacement or candidate-consumed ledger events
same continuation id with mismatched replacement request fingerprint rejects before replaying old evidence
VSIX protocol validators accept the replacement target/result shape and reject raw fields
no new RPC, readiness/report/history/digest/inspection wrapper, generic network execution, or VSIX-owned policy is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test covers registry selection -> selected fetch continuation -> selected provenance verification continuation -> selected approval continuation -> selected approved candidate active replacement continuation success
Rust replay test covers no duplicate active replacement or ModePackCandidateConsumed event for same replacement continuation request
Rust denial coverage includes mismatched replacement request fingerprint and checkpoint/selection/approval evidence validation
VSIX protocol tests validate the new bounded replacement target/result shape and reject raw data fields
cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, pnpm install, pnpm guard:diagnostics, pnpm guard:phase-value, VSIX check/test/build, and git diff --check run before PR merge
